# Part 2 - Data Center Construction

An [August 2026 Elon Poll survey](https://www.elon.edu/u/elon-poll/) asked about opinions on data center construction. The specific question was

> Data centers are typically large buildings that contain computers and their infrastructure. If a large data center were proposed to be built in your local community, would you support or oppose its construction?

We are going to explore differing opinions by Democrat and Republican respondents.
